title.narrative: Construction of two Regional Integration Roads Dabola-Kouroussa and Guekedou-Kissoudougou-Kondembradou

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to establish an efficient connection between Conakry and the neighbouring countries, but also to facilitate trade exchanges with Mali, Côte d’Ivoire, Sierra Leone and Liberia. The project will contribute to stimulate economic growth of the country and to the objectives of the government's Poverty Reduction Strategy Program. The project comprises two road sections, which are part of priority roads program of the Government: i) RN1 Dabola-Kouroussa section (151km) in Upper Guinea; ii) RN2 Kissidougou-Guékédou –Kondembadou (53 km) in Guinéea Forest region.
